# Ra.One
*Ra.One* is a 2011 Indian science-fiction action film centered on Shekhar Subramaniam, a video game designer whose creation, a self-aware antagonist named Ra. One, escapes into the real world with lethal intent after a technological breakthrough allows digital entities to enter reality. When Ra. One targets Shekhar's son Prateek (alias Lucifer) in pursuit of his unfinished game vendetta, Shekhar is killed, and Prateek—with the help of the game's protagonist, G.One (played by Shah Rukh Khan)—must navigate a fight for survival against Ra. One’s destructive AI. The film blends video game logic, action setpieces, and themes of the power of good versus evil, and features advanced visual effects and motion capture; G.One and Ra.One's superhuman abilities are linked to the H.A.R.T device, which is central to both the plot and their ultimate weakness.
The cast includes Shah Rukh Khan in a dual role (Shekhar/G.One), Arjun Rampal as Ra.One, Kareena Kapoor as Sonia, and cameo appearances by Amitabh Bachchan (voiceover), Priyanka Chopra, Sanjay Dutt, and Rajinikanth (as Chitti). Noted for its high production budget, extensive VFX, and aggressive marketing, *Ra.One* became the most expensive Bollywood film at the time and set records for pre-release revenue and international distribution. Its reception was mixed—critics praised the visual effects and ambition, but criticized the story and character depth. The film won numerous awards for its technical achievements, especially in special effects, and sparked ongoing discussions about sequels, though nothing definitive has materialized.
